description: GitHub Actions using deprecated or mismatched versions
remediation: Update action versions to approved releases; use semantic versioning

description: Unused import statements and code quality violations in workflow scripts
examples: Unused variable in GitHub Script step
Import statements not used in workflow job
Dead code paths in shell scripts
remediation: Run ruff/pylint; clean up import statements; remove dead code

description: Potential shell injection vulnerabilities in workflow scripts
examples: Insufficient input validation in GitHub Script
remediation: Quote all variables; validate inputs; use GitHub secrets; enable secret scanning

description: Test suite failures due to import errors and missing dependencies
remediation: Fix sys.path; install missing dependencies; update lock files

description: Test suite failures due to failed assertions and test logic
remediation: Debug test logic; check test data; increase timeout if needed

description: Job timeouts and resource exhaustion issues
examples: Out of memory in Python process
remediation: Optimize build; increase timeout; parallelize; clean up artifacts

description: Workflow YAML syntax errors and configuration issues
remediation: Validate workflow YAML; check parameter names; use actionlint

description: Failures not matching known patterns; require investigation
remediation: Investigate logs; create minimal reproduction; escalate to team
